grades: Rising high school seniors (going into senior year), Georgia students
name: Georgia Ready Summer Institute (UGA)
org: University of Georgia, Office of Academic and Community Engagement
what_you_do: This is a one week program living on the UGA campus. Students explore research and learn about entrepreneurship. They build public speaking skills. They tour research labs.
who_can_apply: High-achieving high school students from across Georgia who are going into their senior year. No other rules are listed on the pages read. In 2026 exactly 50 students were chosen from 664 applications.
pay_detail: Free to attend. The pages say there is no cost and that housing and meals are included.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed (the application page says the deadline passed). Dates for the next cycle are not posted. Contact oace@uga.edu for future application cycles.
how_to_apply: Apply through the UGA Admissions application portal when it opens. Ask the Office of Academic and Community Engagement (oace@uga.edu) about future cycles. Admissions phone on the application page: 762-400-8800.
notes: Very competitive: a UGA news story dated Sep 3, 2026 says the program got a record 664 applications for 50 spots. Exact 2026 dates and application requirements were not on the pages the reader could open.
